reading_guidance.lead_line: Purpose of this reading: Revision is retrieval-first. Open the CMP only at a failed locus on the Publication Front chain — not as a re-teach of all of Chapter 1–2.1.
focus_questions: Which CR Learning LO is stickiest closed-book?
Where will you reopen the CMP (failed locus only)?
What claim must you refuse (spine / until-exam / Approver clearance)?
misconception_watch: Watch for re-teaching the whole opening arc as Learning.
Watch for claiming Approver clearance from Revision.
Watch for claiming spine / until-exam complete.
reading_guidance.open_point: CMP · only at failed Publication Front locus
reading_guidance.stop_condition: After closed-book retrieval of CR chain and targeted CMP reopen at failures — stop before claiming Approver clearance, until-exam trust, or spine PASS
out_of_scope_today: Certified Educational Coverage increase from catalogue alone
reading_guidance.annotation_task: List stickiest CR LO before any CMP reopen

reading_guidance.worked_examples_cue: If a locus fails, reopen CMP only there — attempt the failed step before uncovering.
reading_guidance.exit_line: Keep CMP closed for first-pass retrieval. Reopen only at failed loci. Kwalitec is the guide; the CMP is authoritative. Stop when retrieval + targeted reopen are done — refuse Approver clearance, spine PASS, and until-exam claims.
reading_guidance.return_cue: You are finished when CR Learning LOs are retrieved closed-book (with targeted reopen only where needed) and forbidden claims are refused.

reading_guidance.reentry_line: Welcome back. Keep your CMP closed unless returning to a failed locus. Immediate next: Knowledge Checks.

knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: Publication Front chain
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. List the nine CR Learning LOs in order and give one warrant sentence for your stickiest LO.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Chain: 1.1.1–1.1.4, 1.2.1–1.2.3, 2.1.1–2.1.2. Name the stickiest LO with one warrant.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Skipping order or claiming Approver clearance.

knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: refuse Approver / spine / until-exam
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. A colleague says 'Placing continuous families means aims, reproducibility, EDA, and discrete matching are all solid.' Refuse; name the weakest link on today's retrieval chain; name one concrete residual to rework.
knowledge_checks.body: Refuse Approver / spine / until-exam swallow after Revision.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Refuse: Publication Front Revision ≠ Approver honesty clearance, ≠ first-pass spine PASS, ≠ until-exam trust. Honest residual: human Publication Approver seals remain required; Coverage stays 63/72 until sealed.
